title: CODAG: Characterizing and Optimizing Decompression Algorithms for GPUs
relevance: Proposed novel GPU kernel architecture for decompression that eliminates specialized thread groups, achieving 13.46x speedup for RLE and 1.18x for Deflate.

title: GSST: Parallel string decompression at 191 GB/s on GPU
relevance: Achieved 191 GB/s decompression on A100 with GPU-optimized FSST, completely dominating LZ-based compressors including GDeflate.

title: GPU implementations of deflate encoding and decoding
venue: Concurrency and Computation: Practice and Experience
relevance: GPU DEFLATE implementation achieving 4.13x-36.56x speedup over single-thread CPU using SKSS technique and gap arrays for parallel Huffman decoding.

title: Accelerating GPU Data Processing using FastLanes Compression
relevance: Demonstrates that data-parallel compression (FastLanes) can make GPU query processing 2x faster than uncompressed, reversing the usual decompression overhead.
